target_claim: where Su (resp. Sv) denotes the set of vertices in the component of T -u (resp. T -v) containing v (resp. u). But then |Su| + |Sv| > n, whereas Su and Sv are disjoint subsets of V (T) (aside from u, v themselves) covering V (T) \ {u, v}, so |Su| + |Sv| = n -2 < n
